messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — steering-controller detected sudden drop in latency confidence for region eu-west-1, high percentage of traffic being steered to us-west-2 unexpectedly. Alert id: SC-2026-8893. Root metric: steering.latency_confidence.eu-west-1 dropped from 0.98 -> 0.45 in 60s.
Mike: seeing the same in the dashboard. spikes in tail latency for EU customers.
Ana: confirming traces — many EU requests are showing origin-region=eu-west-1 but egressing via us-west-2, RTT jump ~220ms.
Ben: any recent route policy changes? I don't see commits in the last 6 hours.
Carol: no manual changes. autoscaler did a few capacity moves earlier but nothing touching steer policies.
Mike: @oncall-sre are you here? can you take the page, please?
oncall-sre: on it. grabbing playbook: region-steer-fallback. My immediate plan: 1) pin critical routes for eu-west-1 to avoid further cross-region steering, 2) roll back any recent steering config, 3) open customer impact note.
Product Lead: customers reporting degraded response times in EU dashboards — some support tickets already. Need an ETA.
Ana: digging into steering-controller logs. I see a spike of invalid probe values from eu-west-1 probe service starting 3300007730. probes returned 503 for ~3 min causing confidence drop.
Ben: that would explain it — steering uses probe success+latency. If probes lied low, steering would shift. Did probe service have a deploy?
Carol: there was a canary deploy to probe-agent at 3300007600 but it rolled forward. Not sure of health.
Mike: ok let's execute the pin. I'll run the pin command for eu-west-1 to force-local routing while we investigate.
Mike: ```
# pin eu-west-1 steer at priority 100 for 30m
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/steer/pin" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CP_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"region":"eu-west-1","priority":100,"ttl_mins":30}'
```
oncall-sre: pin applied, confirmed via controlplane: steer.pin.active{region="eu-west-1"} = true. routing table shows >95% local routing now.
Product Lead: publishing initial customer note: "We are investigating increased latency for some EU customers. We've applied a routing safeguard and are working on root cause." Will update channel once we have more.
Ana: probe-agent service logs show repeated 503s due to a mis-configured health-check path after the canary. Canary changed path from /health to /ready — probes still hitting /health. So probe aggregate reports failures.
Ben: oh wow. So a deploy partially changed readiness endpoint without updating probe config. Is that in the agent or the controller?
Carol: it's in the agent build. The canary had a mismatch, but rollout continued because the canary metric gating didn't include probe path test.
Mike: action items: 1) rollback probe-agent canary to previous image (Ben), 2) patch gating to include probe path test (Ana), 3) extend pin TTL until rollback confirmed (oncall-sre), 4) collect impacted customer list for follow-up (Product Lead).
Ben: initiating rollback now. `kubectl -n infra set image deploy/probe-agent probe-agent=probe-agent:1.6.2-canary` -> rolling back to probe-agent:1.6.1.
Ana: I'm adding an integration check in the steering CI to verify probe path before gating. I'll open PR after rollback.
oncall-sre: rollback in progress, watch pods. pod probe-agent-7f9bb crashed then restarted ok on older image. health checks passing. steering probe success for eu-west-1 back to ~0.98 at 3300007850.
Mike: increasing pin TTL to 2 hours while we watch.
Mike: ```
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/steer/pin" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CP_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"region":"eu-west-1","priority":100,"ttl_mins":120}'
```
oncall-sre: pin TTL extended.
Product Lead: updated customer note: "We've applied a temporary routing safeguard and rolled back a recent agent change causing false probe failures. Traffic is returning to normal; we'll keep the safeguard in place while monitoring." Sent to customers@ and status page.
Ana: monitoring latency and steering controllers — looks stable for the last 4 minutes; eu-west-1 traffic returning to normal.
Ben: sanity check: no other regions affected. probe-agent canary config was only in eu-west-1 deployment.
Carol: adding a postmortem tracker item: include readiness-path check in canary gating and add a synthetic probe in eu-west-1 that mirrors production path.
Mike: thanks team. moving to action items. I'll start an incident timeline draft and assign owners.
Product Lead: please tag any clients who opened tickets; we'll send targeted follow-up.
Ana: creating PR for gating test: https://git.internal/r/steering/+/PR-478 (will link in postmortem).
oncall-sre: closing page at 3300007899 — system health stable, routing pins in place, rollback validated. If anything regresses reopen. :thumbsup:
Mike: good job. postmortem and CLs assigned.
Carol: filed postmortem entry: PM-2026-8893, will schedule RCA sync tomorrow 10:00 UTC.
Product Lead: will prepare customer follow-up email with timeline and mitigation details.
IncidentBot: Incident closed by oncall-sre at 3300007899. Duration 122s (first alert -> close).
